verdict: Leads dropped sharply this week; we're refreshing the ad approach now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 99 leads at an average cost of $7.46 per lead, but that 28-day figure masks a steep drop in the most recent week — leads fell 44.83% compared to the prior 7 days, pushing the recent cost per lead up 83.46% on nearly flat spend. The retargeting campaign that absorbed roughly half of all spend this period has been reaching the same warm audience repeatedly, and that pool appears to be thinning out. Ad creative and audience targeting are being refreshed this week to open new demand outside that saturated group. Separately, 102 leads have entered your pipeline this period but none have converted to booked appointments, which points to a gap in the intake or follow-up process — that is being reviewed alongside the ads work.

watch_item.issue: Lead volume is declining week over week as the retargeting audience becomes exhausted, and 102 pipeline leads have not converted to any booked appointments.
watch_item.fix: Ad creative and audiences are being refreshed this week to reach new prospects, and the intake-to-booking process is under active review to close the pipeline leak.
